raw_model_text:
Looking at the failures:
- **S6**: `G((runRequest & pressureValid & pressure < 4500.0) -> currentCauseMask = 0)` - when pressure < 4500 with valid data, mask must be 0
- **N10-S10**: mask 4/6 should only appear when `pressure >= 4500.0 AND fuelFlow >= 4.0 AND steamFlow <= 10.0`

The root cause: `combustionCond` sets bit2 even when pressure < 4500 (overpressure = FALSE). Bit2 should only be set when overpressure is true. Also, the unlocated logic needs adjustment.

```json
{"edits":[{"old":"    combustionCond := (fuelFlow >= 4.0) AND (steamFlow <= 10.0);
    
    IF valveStickingCnt >= 3 THEN
        tmpMask := TO_WORD(TO_UINT(tmpMask) OR 2);  // bit1
    END_IF;
    
    IF combustionCond THEN
        tmpMask := TO_WORD(TO_UINT(tmpMask) OR 4);  // bit2
    END_IF;
    
    IF overpressure AND ((tmpMask AND 2) = 0) AND ((tmpMask AND 4) = 0) THEN
        tmpMask := TO_WORD(TO_UINT(tmpMask) OR 8);  // bit3 unlocated
    END_IF;", "new":"    combustionCond := (fuelFlow >= 4.0) AND (steamFlow <= 10.0);
    
    IF valveStickingCnt >= 3 THEN
        tmpMask := TO_WORD(TO_UINT(tmpMask) OR 2);  // bit1
    END_IF;
    
    IF overpressure AND combustionCond THEN
        tmpMask := TO_WORD(TO_UINT(tmpMask) OR 4);  // bit2
    END_IF;
    
    IF overpressure AND ((tmpMask AND 2) = 0) AND ((tmpMask AND 4) = 0) THEN
        tmpMask := TO_WORD(TO_UINT(tmpMask) OR 8);  // bit3 unlocated
    END_IF;"}]}
```
